page_title: BOC 1-2 FRE | Bochum v Freiburg 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Marco Fritz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+6' Takuma Asano (Bochum) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the left post. Very poor attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
90+3' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Merlin Rohl (Freiburg). Marco Fritz saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
90+2' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.

90+1' The corner is swung in and Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) replaces Ritsu Doan.
89' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away. The ball is out of play. Bochum win a corner kick.
89' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner which is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Bochum have been awarded a corner kick.
88' Bochum keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
84' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Freiburg are going to take it.
83' The referee gives a yellow card to Christian Gunter (Freiburg).
82' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
81' Freiburg are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
77' A cross from a corner kick by Bochum is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

76' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
75' Here is a change. Matthias Ginter is going off and Christian Streich gives the last tactical orders to Lukas Kubler (Freiburg).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Michael Gregoritsch as he is replaced by Merlin Rohl (Freiburg).
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Holer (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Marco Fritz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Christian Streich prepares a substitution. Roland Sallai is replaced by Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
69' Here's the change. Vincenzo Grifo leaves the pitch and Florent Muslija (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
68' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
68' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) commits a rough challenge and Marco Fritz blows his whistle for an infringement.
66' Bochum hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
62' 1 - 2 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Ivan Ordets (Bochum) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:2.
62' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
60' Thomas Letsch has decided to make a change. Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) replaces Moritz Broschinski.
60' Substitution. Philipp Forster walks off the pitch and Lukas Daschner (Bochum) comes on as a substitute.
59' Yellow card. Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
57' Some patient build-up play from Bochum as they look to unlock the defence.
53' 0 - 2 It's a goal! Ritsu Doan sends a long raking pass onto the head of Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Freiburg comes to nothing.
47' Bochum fail to score from a corner as Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) leaps to collect the ball.
46' Thomas Letsch makes a switch. Philipp Hofmann is coming on in place of Tim Oermann (Bochum) at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
45+4' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) is given a yellow card.
45+2' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
45+1' The foul by Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) was seen by Marco Fritz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

43' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Noah Atubolu, who pulls off a comfortable save!
42' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
39' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
39' One of the Bochum players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
38' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Freiburg was in an offside position.
36' 0 - 1 It's 0:1! Michael Gregoritsch feeds Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
35' Noah Atubolu leaps to intercept the corner kick from Kevin Stoger (Bochum).
34' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
34' What was Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
33' Bernardo (Bochum) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
30' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Roland Sallai (Freiburg) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
28' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
27' Takuma Asano (Bochum) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
26' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

24' Manuel Riemann pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.

22' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
21' Freiburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
18' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
17' Freiburg are seeing far more of the ball now.
14' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
13' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Noah Atubolu is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
10' A spell of possession for Bochum in an attempt to control the game.
8' A player from Bochum commits a rough challenge. Marco Fritz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
4' Bochum hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Bochum will kick-off.
Marco Fritz will supervise the game today.
